summary: LMCACHE_L2_CHECKPOINT_WRITES=on-evict writes checkpoints to disk when they leave RAM
compatibility: Opt-in. With on-evict, stop the container with at least 60 s (docker run --stop-timeout 60, Compose stop_grace_period: 60s) so RAM-only checkpoints reach the disk.
details: on-evict selects the LMCache checkpoint_on_evict store policy: the current checkpoint of a conversation is written once, when RAM evicts it, and superseded checkpoints are never written.
At shutdown LMCache writes checkpoints still only in RAM for up to 30 s; the supervisor waits 40 s before SIGKILL in this mode.
The README describes always, on-evict and on-reuse and how to estimate disk retention.
